subject: Community Spotlight: maintainer credit pool request (OpenForge demo track)
messages:
From: OpenForge Maintainers <maintainers@openforge.dev>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: alex@codetogether.org
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Spotlight credit pool for OpenForge demo track

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the conversation at OSSCon last month — excited about the possibility of Redwood sponsoring our Demo Track. A few of our core maintainers are cash-constrained and we were hoping Redwood could provide a small pool of trial credits (compute + inference) to support 12 teams during the event (3 winners get extended trials).

Rough ask: 3 x 2k compute credits for winners, plus 9 x 200 starter credits for other demo teams (total ~6k credits). We can include Redwood branding on promotional materials and a short lightning session highlighting integrations.

Attached is a short list of the maintainers and a draft outline of the Demo Track. Can you let us know if this is something you can approve and any compliance steps we should expect?

Cheers,
OpenForge Maintainers

--
OpenForge is a community-run foundation supporting open-source infra projects
From: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
To: maintainers@openforge.dev
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Spotlight credit pool for OpenForge demo track

Hi —

Really appreciate the note and the clear ask. Short answers: yes, we generally do small promotional credit pools for community demo tracks; we just need to confirm scope, legal terms for winners, and an SSO/access plan for ephemeral accounts.

Next steps I propose:
- OpenForge to confirm final list of 12 teams + winners by Oct 18 (we need names + emails)
- Redwood to provision a temporary org in our sandbox and allocate the starter credits; winners get extended trial codes (managed via DocuSign or a single-use token list)
- Kar + Marissa to scope the exact credit amounts and compliance checklist (SOC2 evidence for handling tokens, short AUP)

Can Karthik or Marissa jump in on timeline and whether finance needs a PO/a contract for the extended trial credits?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Community Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Spotlight credit pool for OpenForge demo track

+1 on the plan. Quick notes from ops/finance:
- Starter credits (<= 500 USD equivalent per team) can be handled as marketing promo codes — no PO required.
- Extended trial credits (winners) above $1k each should be booked as a promo allocation and we generally require a short form (sponsor acceptance) and a one-page MSA addendum if there's any continued usage beyond 90 days.
- Compliance: we need a list of maintainer accounts and confirmation there is no regulated data expected in demos (PII or customer data).

I'll prepare two promo code batches: 9 starter codes (200 credits each) and 3 winner vouchers (2000 credits each). Marissa, can you confirm the creative/export for branding and whether we want to require a short Redwood attribution in the winner announcement?

Karthik
Sr. Partnerships Ops
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Spotlight credit pool for OpenForge demo track

All good from comms side. A few production notes:
- We'll require winners to include a 10–15 second Redwood mention on the demo stage and a logo on the event page.
- I can assemble a one-page attribution blurb and a tweet-ready kit by Oct 12.
- Attachments: I reviewed the maintainer_list.csv — flagging two entries that don't have public email addresses; request OpenForge provide contactable emails or we can't issue codes.

Rachel, can you confirm the token distribution mechanism? Are we handing out single-use vouchers or preprovisioning sandbox orgs per team? Ops prefers single-use vouchers tied to emails for auditability.

-Marissa
Community Marketing Lead
From: Alex Navarro <alex@codetogether.org>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: maintainers@openforge.dev, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Spotlight credit pool for OpenForge demo track

Thanks — this works great. OpenForge will:
- Finalize the team contact list by Oct 12 (emails included)
- Accept the attribution requirements for winners
- Confirm there will be no regulated customer data in demos

We prefer single-use vouchers as well — makes things easy for our teams. I'll upload the final CSV to the shared Drive folder and ping you when it's live.

Appreciate the quick turnaround! Looking forward to the Lightning session.

Best,
Alex Navarro
Events Lead, CodeTogether / OpenForge Demo Track

--
Attachments referenced: demo-track-outline.docx; sponsor_guidelines.pdf
